messages.text: Keep our exact draft. The disclosed distribution benefit strengthens the case for our chosen Repair and Trade; it requires no new surrender of assets. I still want Guard. Communities four is preferable to three, and the army has proposed offering Vigil. The benefit also supports our argument that commercial traffic and public welfare can reinforce each other under Guild discretion.

reason: This information changes expected civilian outcome and bargaining confidence only. It changes neither assignment, requested order nor promised bargain: we already chose the qualifying actions. Lantern Council remains locked, and Wayfarer Trade remains my voluntary choice. I take the benefit as the Ascendant's disclosed conditional claim and will judge the actual result before treating it as proof of good government.
